description: This source file defines the StaticGatewayListProviderBuilder class, which implements the IProviderBuilder<IClientBuilder> interface. It is responsible for configuring a client builder with static gateway endpoints specified in a configuration section. The class reads 'Gateways' from configuration, parses each endpoint, and applies them to the builder using 'UseStaticClustering'. Additionally, it uses assembly attributes to register the provider under specific names.

classes.name: StaticGatewayListProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements IProviderBuilder<IClientBuilder> to configure static gateway endpoints for Orleans clients based on configuration data.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Reads 'Gateways' from configuration, parses each as IPEndPoint, and adds them to the client builder using UseStaticClustering.
